scope: Read-only live log collection and local tool-error retention; no capture parameter or driver changes.
notes: Use a foreground PTY so cancellation interrupts only this logger; no background process, PID file, mount, install or flash writes.
One shared stream per authenticated SSH connection; no timer and no automatic reconnect/retry.
Retain bounded masked lines in the device journal and existing asynchronous on-disk history for auto-capture and regular capture.
Windows offline verification pending; native Debian and router verification pending.

implementation.live_logs: One foreground PTY logread stream per active authenticated connection, shared by auto and regular capture tasks. Open/close in existing task workers; no new remote polling loop or timer.
implementation.tool_failures: Allowlisted failed capture commands retain sanitized stdout/stderr, exit code, timeout, cancellation and elapsed time; commands and credentials are excluded.
implementation.auto_exit: Record radio, confirmed exit code or unexpected EOF, and connection state before normal cleanup.
implementation.persistence: Bounded per-device diagnostic journal plus existing asynchronous SQLite history in both auto-capture and regular-capture categories; persisted evidence survives application restart.
implementation.failure_isolation: Logging channel refusal/timeout cannot invalidate shared login. Capture result and failure propagation remain unchanged. No auto retry/reconnect. Cancellation interrupts only the foreground logger and closes its owned PTY.
implementation.resource_release: The last capture lease stops and joins the logging worker with a bounded wait and drops the manager-held run/connection reference.

verification.windows: 150 targeted offline tests passed in 20.270 seconds using the project .venv. UTF-8 decode, Python compilation and diff whitespace checks passed. Local POSIX shell syntax and missing-logread protocol tested. Includes history close/reopen/export, two-task shared stream ownership, cancellation, EOF/transport-loss tail, output redaction, and isolated channel timeout.
verification.native_debian12: Not run in this turn; shared Python/Paramiko implementation has no OS-specific branches.
verification.live_router: Not run; no router operations performed.
limitations: A sudden power loss or kernel failure can prevent the very last message from reaching the PC; streamed logging cannot guarantee a crash cause.
logread and PTY availability depend on the actual device. Unsupported/failure states are retained; no packages installed.
The existing command queue remains unchanged; this change records the deauth tool failure instead of guessing its cause.
Changes are source-only and have not been packaged in this turn.
